scope: All component geometry for new simple PixiJS games
units: CSS pixels after responsive layout; texture pixels are separate

inheritance.newGraphics: Generate new project-specific atlases and background
inheritance.newAudio: Select new free commercial game music; create new effects; never generate background music
inheritance.override: Change accepted sizes only for an explicit user-requested layout change; record it

css.allComponents: The exported CSS contains EVERY geometry rule in cascade order, including modals, rewards, collection, tutorial, menus and responsive overrides. Copy it intact and provide your own colors, fonts and artwork.

toolbar.desktop: Content width at the right: review reward, multiplier, player, coins, language, settings; matching top height
toolbar.portrait: Full-width controls row; second full-width row with review reward left and flexible multiplier right
toolbar.settingsIcon: 94% of button side; alpha-trimmed silhouette centered

orders.scale: --order-w / --order-design-width; design width >=176, shared across all cards
orders.layout: One horizontal portrait row, no wrap or horizontal scroll; icon left, counter upper right, price lower right; all parts share one scale
orders.widthRangeMeaning: Desktop 120–196 responsive minimum; portrait width comes from available width / order count, without 120px minimum
orders.width: Desktop max-content; portrait 100% of equal grid cell, min-width:0
orders.fieldInset: Measured orders width on desktop and actual row height in portrait
orders.portraitColumns: repeat(orderCount,minmax(0,1fr)); always one row; no wrap or scroll

navigation.portraitLayout: 4 buttons in one full-width row, icon above text

lockedSections.mobileSizing: Keep full-four-row cell width, center only visible buttons

purchases.portraitWidth: Two equal halves of all available width
purchases.portraitLayout: Image left, price/ad right; entire group centered horizontally and vertically
purchases.desktopLayout: Vertical offers, side by side in landscape below 560px height
purchases.adWidth: max-content; one background; no duplicate title or level text

review.position: Left of multiplier, hidden until player 10 / unavailable review / claimed
review.mobileWidth: max-content; max-width:40%; multiplier gets all remaining width
review.shortLandscape: Below 700px width show image + count; label remains in aria-label
review.reminder: Once per minute, 6 seconds; no automatic dialog
review.mobileLabel: 14–16px; short localized Rate game / Оценить; 18px count; both fit combo row height

battleCooldown.portrait: Fixed right edge, above shop; max-width: viewport minus 2 edges
battleCooldown.content: Remaining time, image and localized skip + advertisement label

field.spriteShape: Square in CSS pixels despite independent X/Y field scales

battle.layout: Always vertical: player above opponent; whole frame centered in the available field on desktop
battle.smallViewport: Scale the whole vertical composition to fit; never split teams into horizontal columns

clickNumber.movement: Same travel distance over 25% more time
clickNumber.paletteRule: Exact same color as matching multiplier band and label

textureGeometry.source: assets/atlases/game.json; coordinates/sizes may be copied, image files may not
